concept.name: Label
concept.definition: The observed class or value assigned to an example as the outcome a supervised model is trained to predict.
concept.intuition: It controls what information the model receives and in what numerical representation.
concept.mechanics: Define the event window and labeling rule, align it after the feature timestamp, and prevent overlapping outcomes from leaking across splits.
concept.failure_modes: Fitting the operation on the full dataset leaks future information; revisions, outliers, and missing values can also distort results.
concept.misconceptions: A cleaner or rescaled dataset is not automatically more truthful; transformations must preserve timing and economic meaning.
concept.example: A row dated Monday receives label 1 if Tuesday's close-to-close return is positive and 0 otherwise.
